indicators.label: MACD

indicators.label: ADX
indicators.summary: Wilder ADX trend strength with +DI and -DI.

indicators.label: OHLCV
indicators.summary: Copies one candle field (open, high, low, close, or volume).

indicators.label: Constant
indicators.summary: A fixed level on every bar, for example an RSI threshold to cross.

parameters.name: value
parameters.label: Value
parameters.help: Exact decimal level, for example 30 or -0.5.

indicators.label: DEMA
indicators.summary: Double EMA, 2 * EMA - EMA(EMA): less lag than a plain EMA.

indicators.label: TEMA
indicators.summary: Triple EMA, 3 * EMA - 3 * EMA(EMA) + EMA(EMA(EMA)).

parameters.name: period
parameters.label: Period
parameters.help: Window of all three chained EMAs.

indicators.label: Hull MA
indicators.summary: Hull moving average: WMA(2 * WMA(n/2) - WMA(n), √n), with n/2 and √n floored.

indicators.label: KAMA
indicators.summary: Kaufman adaptive MA: moves fast in efficient trends, slowly in noise.

parameters.label: Fast period
parameters.help: EMA-equivalent period of the fastest smoothing.

parameters.name: slow_period
parameters.label: Slow period
parameters.help: EMA-equivalent period of the slowest smoothing.

indicators.label: VWMA
indicators.summary: Volume-weighted moving average of close.

parameters.label: Period
parameters.help: Bars in the rolling window (current bar included).

indicators.label: Supertrend

indicators.summary: Wilder stop-and-reverse that accelerates toward the trend's extreme point.

parameters.name: step
parameters.label: Step
parameters.help: Acceleration start and increment per new extreme.

indicators.label: Aroon
indicators.summary: Bars since the period high and low, scaled 0 to 100, and their difference.

indicators.label: Ichimoku

indicators.summary: Least-squares line over period bars: endpoint value and slope per bar.

parameters.name: period

indicators.label: Ultimate Oscillator
indicators.summary: Buying pressure over true range in three windows, weighted 4:2:1 (0 to 100).

indicators.label: Awesome Oscillator
indicators.summary: SMA(fast) - SMA(slow) of the median price (high + low) / 2.

indicators.label: CMO
indicators.summary: Chande momentum oscillator (-100 to 100) from summed gains and losses.

indicators.label: TSI
indicators.summary: True strength index: double-smoothed momentum over its absolute value, with signal.

indicators.label: Keltner
indicators.summary: EMA middle line with bands an ATR multiple away.

parameters.name: period
parameters.label: Period
